mapper.delete: DELETE FROM leetcode_problem_tag WHERE problem_id = #{problemId} AND tag_name = #{tagName}

SELECT tag_name as tagName, tag_category as tagCategory, COUNT(*) as usageCount, AVG(relevance_score) as avgRelevance FROM leetcode_problem_tag GROUP BY tag_name, tag_category ORDER BY usageCount DESC
